title: Maximal extension of Schwarzschild-like spacetimes in Lorentz gauge theory
summary: We study the maximal analytic extension of the Schwarzschild-like black hole solution in Lorentz gauge theory. The lapse function is $f(r)=A_0^{-2}-2\m/r$, so the horizon is located at $r_+=2\m A_0^2$ and the non-affinity coefficient of the horizon generator is $κ=1/(4\m A_0^4)$. We first analyze the radial null curves in the Schwarzschild-Droste (SD) and ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein (IEF) charts, and then construct the Kruskal-Szekeres (KS) chart adapted to the LGT geometry.
